nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances; mutated in _transferStandard, _takeTeam and read by balanceOf.
ERC20 allowance mapping written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Mapping flagging accounts excluded from fees; checked in _transfer.
Blacklist mapping set by aprove and enforced in _transfer.
Per-address cooldown timestamp written in _transfer using block.timestamp.
Total reflections; reduced in _reflectFee and read by _getRate.
Tax fee numerator set in _transfer and consumed by _getValues/_getTValues.
Team fee numerator set in _transfer and consumed by _getValues/_getTValues.
Fee wallet 1; compared against caller in manualswap and manualsend.
Fee wallet 2; ETH recipient in sendETHToFee.
Router instance set in openTrading and used for swaps and liquidity.
Liquidity pair address created in openTrading.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by lockTheSwap and checked in _transfer.
Enables automatic swap-and-send logic in _transfer.
Enables cooldown/timestamp checks in _transfer.
Max transfer amount enforced in _transfer when buying from pair.
Ownable owner address; checked by onlyOwner modifier against _msgSender.
Core transfer routine: blacklist/timestamp checks, auto-swap to ETH and fee routing.
Swaps contract token balance for ETH through the router under lockTheSwap.
Sends accumulated ETH to the fee wallet.
Owner-only bootstrap: sets router/pair, adds liquidity, opens trading.
Applies reflection arithmetic, team fee and burn fee for a transfer.
Fee-wallet-gated manual swap of contract tokens for ETH.
Fee-wallet-gated manual send of contract ETH to fee wallet.
Internal wrapper delegating to _transferStandard.
Transfers on behalf of sender and decrements allowance using caller identity.
Owner-only loop that blacklists addresses in the bots mapping.
Computes r/t fee, team and transfer amounts using current rate.
External ERC20 transfer entry point invoking _transfer.
Returns token balance derived from reflection balance and current rate.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
Mints team share to the contract reflection balance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowances and manual functions.
Miner-influenceable time source used for cooldown and router deadlines.
External swap call that transfers tokens and ETH and can re-enter the token.
External ETH transfer to the fee wallet from sendETHToFee.
External payable liquidity addition during openTrading.
External factory call creating the trading pair.
Destination address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Local holding balanceOf(address(this)) used for the automatic swap.
Local holding address(this).balance before sending to fee wallet.
Sender address parameter of _transferStandard.
Local reflection rate from _getRate used in amount math.
Local net token amount emitted in the Transfer event.

edges.reason: transfer() calls _transfer with caller, recipient and amount.
msg.sender is used as the sender of transfer.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer.
amount parameter flows into _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer internally.
_msgSender is used as spender for allowance bookkeeping.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender.
manualswap requires caller to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend requires caller to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
cooldown mapping is written per recipient in _transfer.
block.timestamp drives the cooldown check and update in _transfer.
contract token balance is derived inside _transfer for the swap.
balanceOf(address(this)) result assigned to contractTokenBalance.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not inSwap.
_transfer forwards contract ETH to sendETHToFee.
contract ETH balance is passed to sendETHToFee.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
Router swap transfers tokens that can re-enter the token _transfer path.
inSwap flag set by lockTheSwap gates swapTokensForEth execution.
sendETHToFee executes the ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
_feeAddrWallet2 is the recipient of the ETH transfer.
openTrading adds liquidity through the router.
openTrading creates the pair through the factory.
Created pair address is stored in uniswapV2Pair.
Router instance is the call target for addLiquidityETH.
Router instance is assigned to uniswapV2Router state variable.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading updates _maxTxAmount.
_maxTxAmount is enforced in the _transfer cooldown branch.
bots blacklist is checked in _transfer.
aprove writes addresses into the bots mapping.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer at the end.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_rOwned sender and recipient balances updated in _transferStandard.
_transferStandard invokes _takeTeam for the team share.
_transferStandard invokes _reflectFee for the burn share.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute amounts.
_feeAddr1 tax rate is read by _getValues.
_feeAddr2 team rate is read by _getValues.
currentRate is used for reflection amount math.
Computed r/t values are returned to _transferStandard.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
sender parameter is used in _transferStandard balance updates.
tTransferAmount is computed by _getValues.
tTransferAmount is emitted in the Transfer event by _transferStandard.
_allowances mapping is read by transferFrom for the allowance deduction.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
_feeAddrWallet1 is compared against the caller in manualswap.
_feeAddrWallet1 is compared against the caller in manualsend.
_isExcludedFromFee exemptions are checked in _transfer.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline parameter.
